content: So far we have compiled the most relevant terms in from the reviews. We now need to weight these terms for each review, so that we know the car-speak terms are most associated with a car. Using TF-IDF (Term Frequency-Inverse Document Frequency) has been used as a reliable metric for finding the relevant terms in a document BIBREF10.
